PAID OFF SOLAR * BACKUP BATTERY * RV HOOKUPS * BARN * The perfect blend of modern efficiency and high-desert charm in this unique, mountain-cabin inspired retreat. Located in the highly sought after Baldy Mesa area of Phelan (SNOW LINE SCHOOL DISTRICT) this home offers the rare opportunity to enjoy a newer build without the wait. Completed in 2023, the 900 sq ft interior impresses with 14-foot vaulted ceilings and a bright, open kitchen equipped with real wood cabinetry and granite countertops. This home is all electric, with paid-off solar panels, a solar water heater, and a backup tankless water heater to help keep utility bills LOW. A backup battery in the garage provides additional peace of mind and energy resilience.

The primary suite features a large walk-in shower, and while the home currently offers two bedrooms and two bathrooms, it is designed to be expandable to 3 or 4 bedrooms and is already plumbed for a third bathroom. Sitting on a fully fenced, nearly one-acre corner lot, the property provides an incredible canvas for your vision. The barn out back offers a versatile space for horses, chickens, goats, and more. Full RV hookups add even more flexibility for recreational use or additional storage needs.

The property also features a sprinkler system, a desirable feature for homeowners looking for added fire protection and potentially favorable insurance considerations. At night, enjoy beautiful views of the city lights while still experiencing everything the high desert has to offer, including miles and miles of trail riding right from your front gate. Convenience is key here, with quick access to the 15 and 395, as well as local shopping and dining. If you’ve been searching for a simple, energy-efficient, and highly adaptable home that can grow with you, this Baldy Mesa gem is a must-see.
